field.label: Voice WAN Interface
field.help: Select the outgoing WAN for voice interception. An empty selection inherits the Strategies WAN. The interface selects interception, not routing; incompatible independent-WAN capture is rejected before activation.

field.label: About Voice Profiles
field.text: This page configures outgoing STUN / UDP interception through the existing Zapret2 engine. The service checkbox controls whether a destination-scoped profile is included on Apply. Each enabled profile requires a nonempty IPv4/CIDR destination IPSET and native dvtws2 parameters. Non-STUN strategies remain on the Strategy page. A profile being enabled does not prove a working voice call.

field.label: Telegram
field.help: Enable this service's STUN profile and destination-scoped UDP interception only after Apply. Disabled services retain their parameters and IP lists.

field.label: Telegram Parameters
field.help: One native dvtws2 STUN profile. Include --filter-udp=* or ports, --filter-l7=stun and --payload=stun. Native Lua actions are optional. The application supplies the profile name, IPv4 filter and shared IPSET. Do not enter --new, TCP options, process flags or shell commands. This does not prove that a voice call works.

field.label: IPSET Telegram
field.help: Shared IPv4 or CIDR targets, one per line. Required when the corresponding service is enabled. These targets are also available to ordinary Strategies as <IPSET:telegram>. No IPv6, hostnames or implicit to any.
